title: EntityMatchResponse
description: Array of matched entities ranked by match quality (best match first). Uses fuzzy name matching across canonical names, common names, and aliases.

id.description: Recorded Future entity ID (use with Lookup and other endpoints)

name.description: Entity display name (may differ from search term)

type.description: Entity type (e.g., CyberVulnerability, Malware, IpAddress, InternetDomainName)
